judge.rationale: The candidate accurately implements the core logic in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` by wrapping non-Error rejections in an `Error` with `{cause: reason}` while passing `Error` instances through unchanged and preserving the original thrown value for the caller. It satisfies every acceptance criterion, including testing string, plain object, `undefined`, and `Error` rejections, and updating `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. However, in `CHANGELOG.md`, the candidate mistakenly inserted the new bullet point into three different `### Changed` sections (including historical releases) instead of only under `[Unreleased]`, and left `.lore/dod.md` in the tree. Additionally, while the reference added a single table-driven test to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` and used `JSON.stringify`/`String` for formatting, the candidate created two new separate test files and used `node:util`'s `inspect`.
